$comment: CANONICAL JSON CONTRACT for ai-native-cli-spec 2.0. Maintained ONLY in ai-native-cli-spec/template/common/contract/contract.json. The aicli libraries (template/go/aicli, template/python/aicli) embed generated constants from this file (scripts/gen-contract.js), and the JSON Schemas in contract/schemas encode the shapes. Tools vendor this file, the schemas and the library pinned to a spec tag (.agent/SPEC_VERSION); scripts/check-spec.js guards against drift. CLI-SPEC.md, SEC-SPEC.md and VERIFY-SPEC.md are the prose; rule IDs are cited per section.

envelope.json_layout: compact by default; --pretty indents; --compact is an accepted no-op

untrusted_paths.syntax: dot-separated keys from the envelope root; [] means every element of an array

formats.unsupported: E_USAGE with problem unsupported_format, emitted as JSON

E_USAGE.meaning: The command line is wrong: unknown command or flag, unexpected argument, missing or invalid parameter.

E_VALIDATION.meaning: The request is well-formed but the upstream or the tool rejected its content.

E_AMBIGUOUS.meaning: A name matched more than one resource; pick one of details.candidates.

E_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: A valid request this build, upstream version or mode cannot carry out.

E_NOT_FOUND.meaning: The resource does not exist or is not visible to this account.

E_AUTH.meaning: Credentials are missing, invalid or expired.

E_FORBIDDEN.meaning: Not allowed: no granted scope (details.scope) or the upstream refused the account (details.required).

E_CONFIG.meaning: Local configuration is missing or invalid.

E_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.meaning: A write needs --dry-run then --confirm <token>, or --dangerous; nothing was changed.

E_CONFLICT.meaning: A precondition failed (details.conflict): token mismatch, expired or used token, state drift, changed scope, unresolved operation.

E_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.meaning: The change may have been applied; look it up with details.lookup before doing anything else.

E_NETWORK.meaning: The upstream could not be reached; nothing was sent.

E_RATE_LIMITED.meaning: The upstream rate limit was hit; wait details.retry_after_ms.

E_SERVER.meaning: The upstream failed while handling the request and nothing changed: a read, or a write the tool knows was not applied. Safe to retry; a write starts again from --dry-run.

E_HUMAN_REQUIRED.meaning: A person must act first (details.action), then run details.resume.

E_PARTIAL.meaning: Some of the change took effect; read the receipt or items; never resend the whole request.

E_VERIFY_FAILED.meaning: The change was applied but the read-back disagrees with the request.

E_VERIFY_INCOMPLETE.meaning: The change was applied but the required read-back could not be completed.

E_INTEGRITY.meaning: A release signature or checksum failed; do not retry.

E_IO.meaning: A local file or the tool's state store failed; nothing was sent.

E_INTERRUPTED.meaning: Interrupted by a signal before anything lasting happened.

E_UNKNOWN.meaning: An internal error; read message and details.

write_rules: During the apply step of a write, a failure after the request may have reached the upstream is E_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, never E_NETWORK, E_SERVER, E_TIMEOUT or E_INTERRUPTED (CLI-015).

E_SERVER, E_TIMEOUT and E_INTERRUPTED are retryable only because they are used for reads or for writes that provably changed nothing; a retried write always starts again from --dry-run because its token is consumed.

rules: An extension code name matches ^E_[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_]*$ and is not a core code name.
An extension code declares {exit, retryable, meaning}.
Its exit is one of the documented exit codes; exit 9 is only for human-action codes.
Its details follow the always-required details keys.

exit_codes.1: failure that needs reading: partial, verify, integrity, io, unknown
exit_codes.2: usage, validation, ambiguous, unsupported (fix the request, do not retry)
exit_codes.4: auth, forbidden, config (credentials, permission or scope)
exit_codes.5: confirmation required (use the preview and token, or add --dangerous)
exit_codes.6: conflict or outcome unknown (re-read state or look the operation up)

E_PARTIAL.note: A partial self-update (binary replaced, Skill sync failed) is E_PARTIAL whose details are the update failure details (CLI-070, update.schema.json $defs/failure_details): the keys above plus status, previous_version, install_method, signature_status, update_available and command.

error_details.gate_conflict_meaning: the conflicts the gate finds itself, before anything is sent: their errors are always dispatch_state not_started

conflict_meaning.token_mismatch: the re-supplied request differs from the previewed one (details.parameter)
conflict_meaning.token_expired: the token is older than its expiry
conflict_meaning.token_used: the token's operation was already confirmed
conflict_meaning.state_drift: the target changed since the dry run (base version differs)
conflict_meaning.scope_changed: the scope file changed since the dry run
conflict_meaning.unresolved_operation: an earlier operation on the same target has an unknown outcome (details.active_operation)
conflict_meaning.lock_held: an operation on the same target is still running (details.active_operation when its owner is known)
conflict_meaning.upstream_conflict: the upstream refused because of its current state (HTTP 409/412)
conflict_meaning.idempotency_mismatch: the idempotency key was used before for a different request
conflict_meaning.idempotency_resolved: the earlier request with this idempotency key was resolved by hand as applied or partial (details.operation_id); it is not sent again

global.--fields: select fields: a,b replaces the defaults; +a adds; all returns everything
global.--dry-run: return the preview and a confirm token; change nothing
global.--confirm: execute the previewed write with its token
global.--dangerous: required in both steps for dangerous commands

per_command_reserved.--profile: the account profile to use (CLI-101); a root flag aicli registers when the tool declares settings, bound into confirm tokens like any other flag

values.change: modifies state on the upstream service
values.deliver: content reaches people or systems outside the target (send, publish, notify, share)
values.configure: changes permissions, settings, credentials, integrations or automation (upstream or the tool's own credentials and profiles)

effects.not_effects: the tool's own operation journal, confirm key and notice cache

values.T1: changes upstream state or local files
values.T2: delivers to others, changes configuration or credentials, or can cause irreversible or account-level damage

token.mac: first 16 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(key, "aicli-confirm/2\u0000" + canonical_claims), lowercase hex
token.key: 32 random bytes at <state_dir>/confirm.key; never an unkeyed fallback
token.canonical_claims: JSON object with sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8: {v, tool, tool_version, op, cmd, inv, inputs, account, host, target, scope, base, idem, exp}

preview.shortening: total counts every target of a batch preview. When the whole preview would break its envelope's size budget (CLI-042), targets and items keep their first entries, in input order and one to one, and omitted is the number of targets left out (total = listed targets + omitted); inputs and the token still cover every target. omitted is absent from a full preview and from a single-target preview.
preview.no_token_when: can_apply is false: confirm_token and expires_at are null

receipt_rules.note: Evaluate in order against the receipt; the first rule whose condition holds decides ok and the error code. Profile base: verification not_run with change applied is ok. The driver profile (tool-driver-cli-spec) adds a rule that makes it E_VERIFY_INCOMPLETE.

rules.when: any of execution, change, delivery, persistence is unknown, or execution is running
any of change, delivery, persistence is partial
execution is failed, interrupted or not_started and change is applied, delivery is delivered or persistence is saved
execution is failed, interrupted or not_started
rules.code: the cause code from the apply step (default E_SERVER)
the cause code that made the tool roll back (default E_VERIFY_FAILED)
the cause code from the delivery step (default E_FORBIDDEN)

batch.shortening: summary counts every target. When the full item list would break the response's size budget (CLI-042), a batch result (data or error.details) first leaves out the receipts of items that succeeded (operation show has them), then their results, then lists fewer items: the items with ok false come first and are all kept before any item that succeeded is listed, and omitted is the number of items left out. operation show --id <batch id> lists every item, or, for a batch too large for one response, the items that need attention first, and operation list --batch <batch id> pages through all of them.
batch.ok_rule: ok is true only when every item succeeded; otherwise E_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN if any item is unknown, else E_PARTIAL if any item applied, else the first failed item's code

operation.shortening: operation show keeps the success budget (CLI-042). For a batch record it first shortens the preview (preview.shortening); if the view is still too large, items lists the items that need attention first (status not in done_status), then the others, each group in input order, cut to fit, and items_omitted counts the items left out. items_omitted is absent from a single record and from a batch record that lists every item. operation list --batch <batch id> pages through every item of a batch in input order.

scope.parsing: strict: duplicate keys and unknown keys are invalid

destination_match.url: a granted destination containing :// matches the same scheme and host and a path at or below the granted path (strict URL containment)
destination_match.other: any other granted destination (email address, handle, channel id) matches exactly; it acts as a prefix only when it ends with '/', and then only at '/' boundaries; '@', ':', '#' and '!' are ordinary characters, never append points

files.scope-usage.json: operations dispatched per scope_id, for limits.max_operations; never pruned
files.locks/<hash>.lock: per-target lock held from the confirm checks until the dispatching record is written

protection_meaning.windows-profile-acl: Windows: state dir inside the user profile; protection comes from the profile's default ACL
protection_meaning.windows-explicit-acl: Windows: an explicit owner-only ACL was set and verified
protection_meaning.windows-unverified: Windows: state dir outside the user profile and no explicit ACL verified; doctor warns

pagination.note: When has_more is true, exactly one of next_cursor, next_offset or continuation_reason is present. When truncated is true, truncated_reason is present. count is the items in this response; total, present when the upstream reports it, is the number of items the whole list has (everything scope covers), so a count question needs no paging (CLI-044).

known_types.deprecated: the command or a flag used is deprecated and names its replacement (CLI-081)
known_types.items_omitted: operation show listed only some items of a large batch and names the paging command (CLI-061)
known_types.journal_write_failed: the final operation record could not be written; the result is still returned (CLI-057)
known_types.result_unencodable: the write was dispatched, but the tool's result could not be encoded, so data.result is empty; operation show has the receipt (CLI-057)

exempt: the full reference (CLI-033) and raw-format output

stage_codes.discover: E_USAGE (a bad --target-version, or no such release), E_UNSUPPORTED (runs from source, a development build, or no release has a semver tag; other non-semver tags are skipped), E_CONFIG (an unusable <PREFIX>_CA_FILE), E_NETWORK, E_RATE_LIMITED, E_TIMEOUT
stage_codes.download: E_UNSUPPORTED (no build for this platform, or an asset not served over https), E_IO (the running executable cannot be located), E_NETWORK (including a redirect to plain http), E_RATE_LIMITED, E_TIMEOUT
stage_codes.verify_signature: E_INTEGRITY; E_NETWORK when the Sigstore trust root cannot be loaded
stage_codes.replace: E_IO, E_CONFIG (package unknown or manager missing), E_UNSUPPORTED (the package manager cannot install the target, such as pip and a prerelease), E_INTEGRITY (an unsafe archive entry, or the new binary reports another version)

update.version_rule: strict semver (https://semver.org) with optional leading v; anything else is E_USAGE invalid_value
